records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,

draft.subject: One small next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — so getting one real project in is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week — just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
